name: Arcturus Warden Exo-Carrier
description: A six-legged autonomous carrier platform that moves through terrain no wheeled vehicle can navigate — rubble fields, collapsed infrastructure, vertical surfaces. The Warden is deployed for deep Underworld operations, disaster response, and situations where conventional vehicles cannot reach. Standing four meters tall, it moves with an unsettling insectoid grace that never stops being disturbing no matter how many times you see it. The cargo bay can carry supplies, casualties, or a tactical team. It is equally comfortable with all three.
speed: 30 km/h flat ground, 15 km/h rough terrain, 5 km/h vertical climb
autonomy: Fully autonomous with optional human direction. Terrain AI navigates independently.
armament: Modular weapon mounts (2), crowd suppression systems, smoke deployment.
common_usage: Underworld operations, disaster response, hostile terrain logistics, perimeter denial.
story_hooks: A Warden sent into the deep Underworld comes back alone, its cargo bay sealed and its terrain AI refusing to share mapping data
Someone captures a Warden and reprograms it as a mobile fortress for a Tier 1 community — Arcturus wants it back
physical_description: The Arcturus Warden is a four-meter-tall hexapod frame of weathered titanium-composite plating, its segmented legs articulated with servo-driven joints that leave faint hydraulic fluid streaks down its flanks. Rain and industrial grime have worn its matte gunmetal finish to a dull grey-brown patina, with rust bloom creeping along seams where maintenance crews can't quite keep up. The central cargo pod is a reinforced cube of scarred steel, its hatches bearing impact dents and repair welds, while optical sensors and targeting mounts cluster at the head like the compound eyes of some predatory insect.
